exposure: 0.375% Ropivacaine in Transversus Abdominis Plane Block
0.25% Bupivacaine in Transversus Abdominis Plane Block
cohort: 50 parturients undergoing lower segment caesarean section (LSCS), over 18 years old, scheduled for elective/emergency caesarean section.
finding: 0.25% Bupivacaine and 0.375% Ropivacaine provide comparable postoperative analgesia when used in a Transversus Abdominis Plane (TAP) block following lower segment caesarean section.
